announcements.text: Enlighten IT Consulting LLC, Columbia, Maryland, has been awarded a $332,830,519 firm-fixed-price contract under a Commercial Solutions Opening via the Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace (TSM). This contract provides for an enterprise service solution that is critical in establishing interoperability with Joint Cyber Warfighting Architecture Common Runtime Stack for Data edge analytics, storage, and data transport capabilities within the Integrated Defensive Cyber System architecture. Work will be performed within and outside the continental United States and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2032. This contract was a competitive acquisition via the TSM, and seven offers were received. Fiscal 2026 Air Force operations and maintenance funds; Air Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; Space Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; and Space Force operations and maintenance funds, are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Joint Base San Antonio, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA8307-26-C-B015). (Awarded on Sept. 30, 2026).

announcements.text: Akima Systems Engineering LLC, Herndon, Virginia, was awarded a $49,990,399 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide innovative and agile technical services for next-generation digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and mission systems sustainment in support of joint mission owners. Bids were solicited via the internet with two received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 18, 2029. Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity (W912CH-27-D-A020).

contracting_activity.name: Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan

extracted.description: Technical services for next-generation digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and mission systems sustainment for joint mission owners

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Fort Worth, Texas (N0001923C0003), is awarded a $9,376,464 firm-fixed-price modification (P00029) to a previously awarded contract. This modification adds scope to provide for the upgrades to electronic mate and assembly stations two, three and four at the F-35 Italian final assembly and check-out in support of F-35 production for the Air Force, Marine Corps, Navy, non-U.S. Department of War (DOW) partners, and Foreign Military Sales customers. Work will be performed in Fort Worth, Texas (93%); and Cameri, Italy (7%), and is expected to be completed in March 2028. Non- U.S. DOW partner funds in the amount of $9,376,464 will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
